name: searchTerm
label: Search Term
help: Keyword or phrase to search, from 1 to 50 characters. Either Search Term or Custom Search URL must be provided.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Number of search results to return (max 100)

name: customSearchUrl
label: Custom Search URL
help: URL copied from a LinkedIn content search page after configuring desired filters. When specified, all filter parameters below are ignored entirely.

name: datePosted
label: Date Posted
help: Filter by when the post was published

name: contentType
label: Content Type
help: Filter by the kind of content the post carries

name: postedBy
label: Posted By
help: Filter by who published the post

name: fromMembers
label: From Members
help: Names of people whose posts to keep (e.g., Bill Gates, Satya Nadella). A name alone may match a namesake; if LinkedIn offers no matching option, the search fails with Filter Not Applied.

name: fromMembersWithId
label: From Members (with ID)
help: People whose posts to keep, each pinned by ID: a member URN, profile URL or Sales Navigator lead URL. Combined with From Members.

spec.name: id
spec.label: ID
spec.help: Identifier that pins the filter to exactly this person

name: fromCompanies
label: From Companies
help: Names of companies whose posts to keep (e.g., Microsoft, Google). A name alone may match a namesake; if LinkedIn offers no matching option, the search fails with Filter Not Applied.

name: fromCompaniesWithId
label: From Companies (with ID)
help: Companies whose posts to keep, each pinned by ID: an organization URN, company URL or Sales Navigator company URL. Combined with From Companies.

spec.name: id
spec.label: ID
spec.help: Identifier that pins the filter to exactly this company

name: mentioningMembers
label: Mentioning Members
help: Names of people to look for in post text (e.g., Bill Gates, Satya Nadella). A name alone may match a namesake; if LinkedIn offers no matching option, the search fails with Filter Not Applied.

name: mentioningMembersWithId
label: Mentioning Members (with ID)
help: People to look for in post text, each pinned by ID: a member URN, profile URL or Sales Navigator lead URL. Combined with Mentioning Members.

spec.name: id
spec.label: ID
spec.help: Identifier that pins the filter to exactly this person

name: mentioningCompanies
label: Mentioning Companies
help: Names of companies to look for in post text (e.g., Microsoft, Google). A name alone may match a namesake; if LinkedIn offers no matching option, the search fails with Filter Not Applied.

name: mentioningCompaniesWithId
label: Mentioning Companies (with ID)
help: Companies to look for in post text, each pinned by ID: an organization URN, company URL or Sales Navigator company URL. Combined with Mentioning Companies.

spec.name: id
spec.label: ID
spec.help: Identifier that pins the filter to exactly this company

name: authorCompanies
label: Author Companies
help: Names of companies the post author works at (e.g., Microsoft, Google). A name alone may match a namesake; if LinkedIn offers no matching option, the search fails with Filter Not Applied.

name: authorCompaniesWithId
label: Author Companies (with ID)
help: Companies the post author works at, each pinned by ID: an organization URN, company URL or Sales Navigator company URL. Combined with Author Companies.

spec.name: id
spec.label: ID
spec.help: Identifier that pins the filter to exactly this company

name: authorIndustries
label: Author Industries
help: Industries the post author works in (e.g., Software Development, Technology). Takes specific values available in the LinkedIn interface.
